title: ezdwg ACIS candidate-reference evidence ceiling
mode: Primary-source research and evidence-boundary review; plan-only update
scope: Revisit the previously screened ezdwg route after finding its 3DSOLID ACIS-candidate inspection API and tests.
Separate package release identity from mutable repository source and test outcomes.
Determine whether candidate ACIS record association constitutes independent ACDS/SAT/SAB semantic evidence.
Refine optional peer admission without adding fixtures, dependencies, recurring peer builds, or support claims.

method.kind: Read-only review of PyPI metadata, project README/docs, public type stubs, and tests
method.limitations: PyPI metadata identifies immutable package hashes but does not establish source-commit correspondence. Repository tests and README are mutable main-branch sources. Candidate-handle assertions and API self-consistency checks do not establish authoritative ACIS ownership or B-rep semantics. The provenance and license of ezdwg's acadsharp test corpus were not independently examined.

sources.observed: PyPI lists release 0.16.3 uploaded 2026-10-17, MIT license, macOS universal2 ARM64/x86-64 wheel and source distribution. PyPI reports the upload did not use Trusted Publishing. Project documentation describes a read-focused R13-R2018 DWG parser and an AC1015-only native writer subset.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Exact package hashes support artifact pinning; no package was installed or run, and the PyPI artifacts were not mapped to a specific source commit during this pass.

sources.observed: The README states that DWG-to-DXF uses ezdxf as the writing backend and that native DWG write targets AC1015 with a bounded entity and object subset. Strict mode reports selected unsupported or undecoded content and attribute loss.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Project-declared route and scope only; not independent DXF writer evidence, whole-document preservation, or native application acceptance.

sources.project: ezdwg 3DSOLID ACIS candidate-reference tests and API type stub
sources.observed: The API exposes decode_acis_candidate_infos and high-level candidate records. Tests exercise confidence-scored header-prefers-entity, payload-fallback-header, stream/scan overlap, low-confidence drop, and entity-fallback rules. The AC1032 sample smoke test checks candidate handles against object-map membership and layer handles; it does not parse SAT/SAB topology or validate geometry.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Reverse-engineering candidate association only. Candidate edges and confidence fields are hypotheses, not authoritative owner closure, successful ACIS decoding, valid/closed B-rep, or analytic semantic evidence.

sources.observed: The test names files under test_dwg/acadsharp and compares bulk decode results with per-type decode results from the same library. The fixture corpus provenance and licensing were not reviewed.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Internal API-consistency test only; not independent expected-value evidence. Do not fetch or import the named files without separate provenance review.

sources.observed: cq-acis is separately documented as an experimental profile-bounded SAT/SAB parser/converter using CadQuery/OCCT. No reviewed source establishes integration from ezdwg's candidate-link API into cq-acis. cad2d-ir declares its DWG adapter through ezdwg.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Separate SAT/SAB parsing and 2D downstream projection do not combine into a qualified DWG-to-B-rep route; cad2d-ir is not an independent DWG parser vote.
